worldcombat.skill.yawn.summary: Lets loose a huge, unmissable yawn that leaves drowsiness on the target; it never misses, but the sleep takes a few seconds to arrive. In that window the target can shake the drowsiness off, or another status can take its place and the yawn fails to press through.
worldcombat.skill.yawn.use.0: Pre-plant sleep on a target and act a few seconds later
worldcombat.skill.yawn.use.1: Force an opponent to spend a cleanse, or to take another status first
worldcombat.skill.yawn.use.2: Set up an ally's Dream Eater or Nightmare
worldcombat.skill.yawn.description.0: Sends drowsiness down an unobstructed line with a reach of %1$s; it never misses, and the target counts down %2$s of drowsiness overhead.
worldcombat.skill.yawn.description.1: When the drowsiness runs out the target sleeps for %1$s; while asleep it cannot act until a hit wakes it.
worldcombat.skill.yawn.long.on: Long yawn: drowsiness window ×1.35, sleep ×1.2 and reach ×1.15, at the cost of a longer window and cooldown ×1.1.
worldcombat.skill.yawn.long.off: Short yawn: window ×0.7, quick wind-up and short cooldown, at the cost of sleep ×0.85.
worldcombat.skill.yawn.growth.1: From level %1$s the drowsiness window is %2$s and the sleep %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.yawn.preference.long.h: On: drowsiness window ×1.35, sleep ×1.2, reach ×1.15, but a longer window for the target to shake it off and cooldown ×1.1. Off (short): window ×0.7, quick wind-up and short cooldown, but sleep ×0.85 — press it on fast, sleep them shallow.
worldcombat.skill.yawn.preference.ai.max: Beyond this distance the priority drops to 16 (34 with Mark the far ones on) and the partner closes in before yawning; larger is more willing to plant it from farther away.
worldcombat.skill.yawn.preference.ai.mar: When on, threats beyond 5 blocks get another +8 priority so the partner plants drowsiness on distant targets first.
worldcombat.skill.yawn.preference.ai.lea: When on, the partner will also leave its post to yawn.
